verdict.rationale: AnythingLLM's own materials say it can "Swap models" and list "Dynamic Model Selection" as a feature, and users report running both local and API-hosted models (GPT-4o, Ollama, Hugging Face, open and closed models). The evidence does not name the specific providers or document per-agent or per-conversation switching. missing for 10: named support for Anthropic, Google and OpenRouter, documented per-agent/per-workspace/per-conversation model switching, in-depth first-party provider docs.

support.subject: As a power user, I can plug in multiple model providers — Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, OpenRouter, and more — and switch models per agent or per conversation
